048/**

051@Tag(RegionServerTests.TAG)

053public class TestStoreFileInfo {
054
055  private static final HBaseTestingUtil TEST_UTIL = new HBaseTestingUtil();
056
057  private static final String PLAIN_HFILE_NAME = "abc0123456789abcdef0123456789ab";
058
059  private static FileSystem fileSystemCountingGetFileStatus(FileSystem base,
060    AtomicInteger statCalls) {
061    return new FilterFileSystem(base) {
062      @Override
063      public FileStatus getFileStatus(Path path) throws IOException {
064        statCalls.incrementAndGet();
065        return super.getFileStatus(path);
066      }
067    };
068  }
069
070  private static Path createPlainHFileOnTestFs(Path dir) throws IOException {
071    FileSystem fs = TEST_UTIL.getTestFileSystem();
072    fs.mkdirs(dir);
073    Path file = new Path(dir, PLAIN_HFILE_NAME);
074    try (FSDataOutputStream out = fs.create(file)) {
075      out.write(new byte[128]);
076    }
077    return file;
078  }
079
080  private static StoreContext newStoreContextForTest(FileSystem fs, Path regionDir)
081    throws IOException {
082    RegionInfo regionInfo = RegionInfoBuilder.newBuilder(TableName.valueOf("table1")).build();
083    return StoreContext.getBuilder()
084      .withRegionFileSystem(
085        HRegionFileSystem.create(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration(), fs, regionDir, regionInfo))
086      .withColumnFamilyDescriptor(
087        ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder("cf1".getBytes()).build())
088      .build();
089  }
090
091  /**
092   * Validate that we can handle valid tables with '.', '_', and '-' chars.
093   */
094  @Test
095  public void testStoreFileNames() {
096    String[] legalHFileLink = { "MyTable_02=abc012-def345", "MyTable_02.300=abc012-def345",
097      "MyTable_02-400=abc012-def345", "MyTable_02-400.200=abc012-def345",
098      "MyTable_02=abc012-def345_SeqId_1_", "MyTable_02=abc012-def345_SeqId_20_" };
099    for (String name : legalHFileLink) {
100      assertTrue(HFileLink.isHFileLink(name), "should be a valid link: " + name);
101      assertTrue(StoreFileInfo.validateStoreFileName(name), "should be a valid StoreFile" + name);
102      assertFalse(StoreFileInfo.isReference(name), "should not be a valid reference: " + name);
103
104      String refName = name + ".6789";
105      assertTrue(StoreFileInfo.isReference(refName),
106        "should be a valid link reference: " + refName);
107      assertTrue(StoreFileInfo.validateStoreFileName(refName),
108        "should be a valid StoreFile" + refName);
109    }
110
111    String[] illegalHFileLink = { ".MyTable_02=abc012-def345", "-MyTable_02.300=abc012-def345",
112      "MyTable_02-400=abc0_12-def345", "MyTable_02-400.200=abc012-def345...." };
113    for (String name : illegalHFileLink) {
114      assertFalse(HFileLink.isHFileLink(name), "should not be a valid link: " + name);
115    }
116  }

118  @Test
119  public void testEqualsWithLink() throws IOException {
120    Path origin = new Path("/origin");
121    Path tmp = TEST_UTIL.getDataTestDir();
122    Path mob = new Path("/mob");
123    Path archive = new Path("/archive");
124    HFileLink link1 = new HFileLink(new Path(origin, "f1"), new Path(tmp, "f1"),
125      new Path(mob, "f1"), new Path(archive, "f1"));
126    HFileLink link2 = new HFileLink(new Path(origin, "f1"), new Path(tmp, "f1"),
127      new Path(mob, "f1"), new Path(archive, "f1"));
128
129    StoreFileInfo info1 = new StoreFileInfo(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration(),
130      TEST_UTIL.getTestFileSystem(), new Path(archive, "f1"), link1);
131    StoreFileInfo info2 = new StoreFileInfo(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration(),
132      TEST_UTIL.getTestFileSystem(), new Path(archive, "f1"), link2);
133
134    assertEquals(info1, info2);
135    assertEquals(info1.hashCode(), info2.hashCode());
136  }

138  /**
139   * Plain HFiles should not call {@code getFileStatus} again when opening a reader context if size
140   * and status were established at {@link StoreFileInfo} construction.
141   */
142  @Test
143  public void testCreateReaderContextSkipsRestatForPlainHFile() throws IOException {
144    Path dir = TEST_UTIL.getDataTestDirOnTestFS("plain-hfile-no-restat");
145    Path file = createPlainHFileOnTestFs(dir);
146    FileSystem baseFs = TEST_UTIL.getTestFileSystem();
147    FileStatus listedStatus = baseFs.getFileStatus(file);
148    AtomicInteger statCalls = new AtomicInteger();
149    FileSystem fs = fileSystemCountingGetFileStatus(baseFs, statCalls);
150    StoreFileInfo info = new StoreFileInfo(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration(), fs,
151      listedStatus.getModificationTime(), file, listedStatus.getLen(), null, null, false);
152    assertEquals(0, statCalls.get(), "construction should not stat when size is supplied");
153    statCalls.set(0);
154    ReaderContext context =
155      info.createReaderContext(false, 1000, ReaderType.PREAD, null, null, null);
156    assertEquals(0, statCalls.get(),
157      "createReaderContext should reuse cached status for plain HFiles");
158    assertEquals(listedStatus.getLen(), context.getFileSize());
159    context.getInputStreamWrapper().close();
160  }
161
162  @Test
163  public void testGetReferencedFileStatusSkipsRestatForPlainHFile() throws IOException {
164    Path regionDir = TEST_UTIL.getDataTestDirOnTestFS("plain-hfile-referenced-status");
165    Path file = createPlainHFileOnTestFs(regionDir);
166    FileSystem baseFs = TEST_UTIL.getTestFileSystem();
167    FileStatus listedStatus = baseFs.getFileStatus(file);
168    AtomicInteger statCalls = new AtomicInteger();
169    FileSystem fs = fileSystemCountingGetFileStatus(baseFs, statCalls);
170    StoreFileInfo info =
171      new StoreFileInfo(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration(), fs, listedStatus.getModificationTime(), file,
172        listedStatus.getLen(), null, null, false, listedStatus);
173    statCalls.set(0);
174    assertEquals(listedStatus.getLen(), info.getReferencedFileStatus(fs).getLen());
175    assertEquals(0, statCalls.get(),
176      "getReferencedFileStatus should reuse cached status that does not need refresh");
177    statCalls.set(0);
178    assertEquals(listedStatus.getLen(), info.getFileStatus().getLen());
179    assertEquals(0, statCalls.get());
180  }

182  @Test
183  public void testPlainHFileStatusNeedsRefreshForBlockDistribution() throws IOException {
184    Path dir = TEST_UTIL.getDataTestDirOnTestFS("plain-hfile-needs-refresh");
185    Path file = createPlainHFileOnTestFs(dir);
186    FileSystem baseFs = TEST_UTIL.getTestFileSystem();
187    FileStatus listedStatus = baseFs.getFileStatus(file);
188    AtomicInteger statCalls = new AtomicInteger();
189    FileSystem fs = fileSystemCountingGetFileStatus(baseFs, statCalls);
190    StoreFileInfo info = new StoreFileInfo(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration(), fs,
191      listedStatus.getModificationTime(), file, listedStatus.getLen(), null, null, false);
192    statCalls.set(0);
193    info.getReferencedFileStatus(fs);
194    assertEquals(1, statCalls.get(), "inferred status must be refreshed for block locality");
195    statCalls.set(0);
196    info.getReferencedFileStatus(fs);
197    assertEquals(0, statCalls.get(), "second getReferencedFileStatus should use refreshed status");
198    statCalls.set(0);
199    info.computeHDFSBlocksDistribution(fs);
200    assertEquals(0, statCalls.get(), "block distribution should use refreshed status");
201    statCalls.set(0);
202    ReaderContext context =
203      info.createReaderContext(false, 1000, ReaderType.PREAD, null, null, null);
204    assertEquals(0, statCalls.get(), "reader open should still avoid restat");
205    context.getInputStreamWrapper().close();
206  }

208  @Test
209  public void testTrackerGetStoreFileInfoWithStatusSkipsRestatOnOpen() throws IOException {
210    Path regionDir = TEST_UTIL.getDataTestDirOnTestFS("tracker-with-status-no-restat");
211    Path file = createPlainHFileOnTestFs(regionDir);
212    FileSystem baseFs = TEST_UTIL.getTestFileSystem();
213    FileStatus listedStatus = baseFs.getFileStatus(file);
214    AtomicInteger statCalls = new AtomicInteger();
215    FileSystem fs = fileSystemCountingGetFileStatus(baseFs, statCalls);
216    StoreFileTrackerForTest tracker = new StoreFileTrackerForTest(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration(),
217      true, newStoreContextForTest(fs, regionDir));
218    statCalls.set(0);
219    StoreFileInfo info = tracker.getStoreFileInfo(listedStatus, file, true);
220    assertEquals(0, statCalls.get(), "tracker should not stat when fileStatus is supplied");
221    statCalls.set(0);
222    info.getReferencedFileStatus(fs);
223    ReaderContext context =
224      info.createReaderContext(false, 1000, ReaderType.PREAD, null, null, null);
225    assertEquals(0, statCalls.get(), "open and referenced status should reuse listed fileStatus");
226    assertEquals(listedStatus.getLen(), context.getFileSize());
227    context.getInputStreamWrapper().close();
228  }
229
230  @Test
231  public void testTrackerGetStoreFileInfoWithoutStatusSkipsRestatOnOpen() throws IOException {
232    Path regionDir = TEST_UTIL.getDataTestDirOnTestFS("tracker-no-status-no-restat");
233    Path file = createPlainHFileOnTestFs(regionDir);
234    FileSystem baseFs = TEST_UTIL.getTestFileSystem();
235    AtomicInteger statCalls = new AtomicInteger();
236    FileSystem fs = fileSystemCountingGetFileStatus(baseFs, statCalls);
237    StoreFileTrackerForTest tracker = new StoreFileTrackerForTest(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration(),
238      true, newStoreContextForTest(fs, regionDir));
239    statCalls.set(0);
240    StoreFileInfo info = tracker.getStoreFileInfo(file, true);
241    assertEquals(1, statCalls.get(), "tracker should stat once when fileStatus is absent");
242    statCalls.set(0);
243    ReaderContext context =
244      info.createReaderContext(false, 1000, ReaderType.PREAD, null, null, null);
245    assertEquals(0, statCalls.get(),
246      "createReaderContext should not restat after tracker registration");
247    assertEquals(128, context.getFileSize());
248    context.getInputStreamWrapper().close();
249    statCalls.set(0);
250    info.getReferencedFileStatus(fs);
251    assertEquals(0, statCalls.get(),
252      "getReferencedFileStatus should reuse status from tracker getFileStatus");
253    statCalls.set(0);
254    info.getReferencedFileStatus(fs);
255    assertEquals(0, statCalls.get());
256  }

258  @Test
259  public void testHFileLinkReferenceRetainsReferencePathInReaderContext() throws IOException {
260    Path dir = TEST_UTIL.getDataTestDirOnTestFS("hfile-link-reference-reader-path");
261    Path linkedFile = createPlainHFileOnTestFs(new Path(dir, "linked"));
262    Path missing = new Path(dir, "missing");
263    HFileLink link = new HFileLink(linkedFile, new Path(missing, "tmp"), new Path(missing, "mob"),
264      new Path(missing, "archive"));
265    Path referencePath = new Path(dir, "table=region-" + PLAIN_HFILE_NAME + ".abcd");
266    Reference reference = Reference.createBottomReference(HConstants.EMPTY_START_ROW);
267    StoreFileInfo info = new StoreFileInfo(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration(),
268      TEST_UTIL.getTestFileSystem(), 0, referencePath, 0, reference, link, true);
269
270    ReaderContext context =
271      info.createReaderContext(false, 1000, ReaderType.PREAD, null, null, null);
272    assertEquals(referencePath, context.getFilePath(),
273      "HFileLink reference should retain its logical reference path");
274    assertEquals(128, context.getFileSize());
275    context.getInputStreamWrapper().close();
276  }

278  @Test
279  public void testOpenErrorMessageReference() throws IOException {
280    // Test file link exception
281    // Try to open nonsense hfilelink. Make sure exception is from HFileLink.
282    Path p = new Path(TEST_UTIL.getDataTestDirOnTestFS(), "4567.abcd");
283    FileSystem fs = FileSystem.get(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration());
284    fs.mkdirs(p.getParent());
285    Reference r = Reference.createBottomReference(HConstants.EMPTY_START_ROW);
286    RegionInfo regionInfo = RegionInfoBuilder.newBuilder(TableName.valueOf("table1")).build();
287    StoreContext storeContext = StoreContext.getBuilder()
288      .withRegionFileSystem(HRegionFileSystem.create(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration(), fs,
289        TEST_UTIL.getDataTestDirOnTestFS(), regionInfo))
290      .withColumnFamilyDescriptor(
291        ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder("cf1".getBytes()).build())
292      .build();
293    StoreFileTrackerForTest storeFileTrackerForTest =
294      new StoreFileTrackerForTest(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration(), true, storeContext);
295    storeFileTrackerForTest.createReference(r, p);
296    StoreFileInfo sfi = storeFileTrackerForTest.getStoreFileInfo(p, true);
297    try {
298      ReaderContext context =
299        sfi.createReaderContext(false, 1000, ReaderType.PREAD, null, null, null);
300      sfi.createReader(context, null);
301      throw new IllegalStateException();
302    } catch (FileNotFoundException fnfe) {
303      assertTrue(fnfe.getMessage().contains("->"));
304    }
305  }
